/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import requests,time,urllib.parse,re
query=''
base='https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/Blast.cgi'
params={
 'CMD':'Put','PROGRAM':'blastn','DATABASE':'wgs','QUERY':query,
 'ENTREZ_QUERY':'txid34827[Organism]',
 'HITLIST_SIZE':'20','ALIGNMENTS':'10','DESCRIPTIONS':'20','FORMAT_TYPE':'JSON2_S'
}
r=requests.post(base,data=params,timeout=60)
print(r.status_code)
print(r.url)
print(r.text[:1000])
# parse RID
m=re.search(r'RID = \"(["'^"]+)"|QBlastInfoBegin.*?RID=([''^&'"\\n]+)',r.text,re.S)
print('m',m.group(1) if m else None, m.group(2) if m and m.lastindex and m.lastindex>=2 else '')
PY"
